answer: Sybil clones can flood votes at near-zero cost. Mechanism: each new seat must grow a spiral trust path of 4 countersigns from timber-aged accounts (3+ epochs), linked as a vine graph where each edge burns 0.15 POA of the signer. Cost: 2.5 POA entry bond plus edge fees. Verification: peers reject votes until the spiral path and vine adjacency are on-ledger with distinct timber ages. Failure: if any vine edge reuses a signer within 2 epochs, slash that edge 100% and freeze the seat 1 epoch.
